rows.vgi.doc_llm: Parse an RSS 2.0, Atom, or JSON Feed into one row per entry. The input is either an http(s) URL (fetched over HTTP) or a raw feed document supplied inline; the format is auto-detected. Each row carries the item's sequence, GUID, title, link, publish and update timestamps, author, categories array, summary, and full content. Use it to ingest news/blog/podcast feeds and turn syndicated entries into a queryable table.

rows.vgi.doc_llm: Import auto feed items using COPY FROM an HTTP(S) URL or worker-local file. Target columns must be a subset of feed_items columns with matching names and types. timeout_ms defaults to 15000; max_items defaults to 0 (all items). Documents over 64 MiB or over one million items are rejected.
rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Import feed items

Import auto feed items using COPY FROM an HTTP(S) URL or worker-local file. Target columns must be a subset of feed_items columns with matching names and types. timeout_ms defaults to 15000; max_items defaults to 0 (all items). Documents over 64 MiB or over one million items are rejected.

### Column mapping

The destination table chooses the output schema. Use any subset of the item columns, in any order, with matching types. Dates are plain `TIMESTAMP`; categories are `VARCHAR[]`. Unknown columns and incompatible types are errors.

### Example

```sql
CREATE TABLE headlines (title VARCHAR, link VARCHAR);
COPY headlines FROM 'https://hnrss.org/frontpage' (FORMAT 'feed.auto', timeout_ms 5000);
```

Local file paths refer to the worker's filesystem, including for remote workers.
rows.vgi.result_dynamic_columns_md:
The COPY destination selects any subset and order of these columns.

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| seq | BIGINT | Zero-based position in the feed. |
| guid | VARCHAR | Item ID, or empty when absent. |
| title | VARCHAR | Item title. |
| link | VARCHAR | Item URL. |
| published | TIMESTAMP | Publish time in UTC; NULL when unavailable. |
| updated | TIMESTAMP | Update time in UTC; NULL when unavailable. |
| author | VARCHAR | Author name or email. |
| categories | VARCHAR[] | Category names; empty list when absent. |
| summary | VARCHAR | Item summary. |
| content | VARCHAR | Full item content. |

rows.vgi.doc_md:
## Generate a atom feed

Export atom using COPY TO a worker-local file. Source columns are matched by feed_items column names and types. title and link options are required; RSS also requires description. Optional language and author describe the feed. Use ORDER BY to choose item order. Missing item IDs are generated deterministically; Atom dates default to the export time.

### Input and output

Alias and cast source columns to the item schema; subsets are supported. This is a sink with no result columns. DuckDB reports the COPY row count. Every item needs title, summary, or content; Atom requires a title. Empty input produces a valid empty feed.

### Example

```sql
COPY (SELECT 'First post' AS title, 'https://example.com/1' AS link)
TO '/tmp/posts.feed' (FORMAT 'feed.atom', title 'Posts', link 'https://example.com', description 'Recent posts');
```

### Limits

Only worker-local destinations are supported. Buffered input and encoded output are limited to 64 MiB, and exports to one million items. The destination is replaced after successful encoding.
